Modern entity_interaction_range additive deltas are paralysis1, vision4, crush2, infinite150; modern block_interaction_range deltas are crush2, atom2, spatial6. No match removes both modern attributes plus legacy aliases, writes none. Legacy forge:block_reach/entity_reach/attack_range requests use UUID/name/amount/add syntax; pinned Vanilla register instead accepts ResourceLocation id, numeric value and add_value, so legacy add syntax is not promoted as a second effective modifier or independent scalar. Slash-prefixed legacy attack removal and native command order are retained; legacy registry availability is not assumed. All requests bind @s to ticked Player and use one ID d08c99dd-c47a-4c6f-842f-084efe6ef91e. Native success is not inspected: the profile latch can prevent retry after a failed request, and missing/changed actual modifiers are not repaired here. Untamed with Player in full-side15 tames to nearest Player, not an incoming-hit owner/flag-filtered Player. Tamed checks owner identity in inflate3; if absent and owner nonnull, absolute homing divides by unshifted three-dimensional owner distance, Y numerator adds.6, factor.3; no added zero-distance guard. First unlocked call sets variantlock=true BEFORE checking owner, so ownerless calls can lock none. Clears six synchronized found-color flags; only other tame same-owner Scarabs in inflate12.5 populate them. Separate foundotherscarab boolean tests ANY other entity same owner, but has no additional gameplay reader in this helper. Starts gold, sequentially downgrades through purple/iridescent/greengold/green/brown when owner color count<=0 OR matching color found OR Player matching sealed-item cooldown OR owner justsummoned-color false; final invalid brown server-discard. No reevaluation after lock. Tamed nonnull-owner count-sum<=0 server-discard. Query inflate7.5, owner Player identity only: native Resistance5/amps brown0,green1,greengold1,iridescent2,purple2,gold3 each call, no effect-applier argument/hurt-success check. Non-brown/non-green dashtime<=0: with target write absolute yaw motion(X divisor2,currentY,Z divisor8),then reset20 even without target;positive decrements1. Gold target Slow10/1 then self Strength10/1;purple target Slow10/0 then self Strength10/0;iridescent/green/greengold self Weakness10/0;brown self Weakness10/1, all server Living requests with flags false,false and ignored returns. Tamed nonnull-owner retarget<=0 resets50, scans all inflate5 sorted; each Mob targeting owner makes this Scarab target that Living mob, so last eligible sorted iterator wins, no added ally filter. Positive decrements1; dead current target cleared with native caught exception. Custom MOVE goal starts when target exists and move controller has no wanted position, continues while wanted+alive target. Start aims at target eye with speed1; tick intersecting bounding boxes calls inherited doHurtTarget EACH goal tick without local cooldown, return ignored;else squared distance<16 reissues eye chase speed1. Registered native OwnerHurtTargetGoal remains native team/admission. Cosmetic textures/animations/particles and random-stroll search are context, not new damage. Only successful hurt admits native knockback, post-attack enchantment callbacks and setLastHurtMob; the custom Scarab goal ignores this boolean. Status requests above are tick-driven, not conditional on that melee return. Independent sourceful global LivingDeathEvent branch forScarab cancels,requestsHP1,cancelsAGAIN,thenserverdiscardsvictim. Bothnonnullvictim/causerrequired;anonymousdeathskipsglobalbranch. No owner/color/goldflagcleanuphere. This composeswith locked intrinsicincomingdiscard and native ticklifecycle,not a secondScarab family.

effects.display_name: Sealed scarab inventory native incoming summon/cleanup package
effects.actual_behavior: VICTIM Player: each prior justsummoned color flag true independently schedules4 ticks to clear that flag, without recheck. Reset six count fields to0, scan modifiable entity item handler copies: matching sealed items add stack counts. Every SingularitySatchel also adds native item-handler slot counts89brown/88green/87greengold/86iridescent/85purple/84gold, without validating the item type stored in that slot; absent capability gives empty stacks. Clamp each count>10 to10; no item consumption. For each positive color count, fresh inclusive nextInt((int)count,10)==10 admits; gold alone uses(int)Math.round(count). Nearest Scarab full-side25 selection is NOT filtered by owner or color: matching owner plus separately queried nearest persistent scarab string equal that color skips it. A nearby nonmatching scarab permits spawn without sealed-item cooldown check; only the no-nearby path skips when Player matching item is on cooldown. Spawn SCARAB_SUMMON(server,MOB_SUMMONED,event position), then successful result gets absolute(inclusive int[-1,1],0,inclusive int[-1,1]). Most justsummoned flags are set before spawn; gold no-nearby flag is set AFTER spawn. No owner/color is explicitly assigned here; first native tick owns that decision. Six independent rolls are preserved. If count sum>0, reset highestscarab=none and find highest synchronized DATA_scarab among owned Scarabs in inflate12.5, priority brown<green<greengold<iridescent<purple<gold. Second same query discards server OWNED despawnable scarabs whose synchronized color EQUALS the highest found color, not weaker colors. Player matching sealed item receives cooldown200 per admitted iterator. Proximity admission reads persistent scarab, ranking/cleanup reads synchronized DATA_scarab; no one-per-owner/color guarantee is invented.

effects.display_name: Tormentor Player-root follow placement and chunk request lifecycle
effects.actual_behavior: Raw alternatechunktormentor=true is independent of current map health. Queue200 clears reload_render in the captured world without health/flag recheck. A full-side64 TORMENTOR query at map XYZ in current world resets or increments failed find attempts. Four independent live reads of F=TORMENTOR_FOLLOW_SPEED (default25, define has no range clamp) compute new X/Z=PlayerAxis+(mapAxis-PlayerAxis)*(100-F)/100 and Y=PlayerY+(mapY-PlayerY)*(100-F)/100+F*2. If distance>550 and old-position query finds a Tormentor, server NULL-source command at old map XYZ requests nearest type=arphex:tormentor,limit1 teleport to the three computed doubles. Query actor and command-selected actor are not bound together. Map XYZ are updated/synced independently even when no server command ran or the request failed; raw alternate flag clears regardless. Normal branch requires !alternate and map health>0, nonempty follow UUID equal to noncreative ticked Player, and torteletime<=0. It first requests chunk removal once and marks chunk_removal_complete=true independent of command success. When entity_loaded<=0, wrap-yaw/rotation changes only tracked presentation state. It then resets torteletime60 BEFORE searching: absence of any Tormentor in full-side600 around callback XYZ plus presence in full-side64 around map XYZ permits the same live F formula. Fresh uniformInt(1,20)==5 OR distance>400 requests the same nearest teleport and separately updates map XYZ. Otherwise absent map query sets alternate=true; if chunk_removal_complete, writes false, records current Player dimension, requests forceload add at map XYZ and resets force_unload_repeats10. The add command is bound to Player; teleport/remove commands use null actor. Positive torteletime decrements1 only in this matched normal branch. Native cleanup: health<=0 removal recipe lacks the space before run; alternate removal recipe has only two positioned coordinates. Both requests still decrement repeats independently of success. Normal removal has three coordinates and a space, but also records completion without a success result. These exact native requests do not prove chunks were loaded/unloaded. No owner/team filter or guaranteed entity transfer is added.
